senses.gloss:
vāpa (Ep. Ind., Vol. XV, p. 310, note 4), explained as a handcast or handful; but really, the same as vapa, sowing [seed grains appa ently by handcast].
 (EI 15), cf. kulyavāpa (area requiring one kulya measure of seeds to be sown by handcast); see vāpa-gatyā, etc.
 (EI 3), a land measure.
vāpa-gatyā, cf. vauge (EI 10), grain sown broadcast.

vāpī (EI 13), step-well; an irrigation well; same as vāpikā.
 (Ep. Ind., Vol. VII, p. 46, note 8), a well with a flight of stairs; cf. kūpa which is an ordinary well.
 (EI 22), a reservoir of water.
vāpikā (CII 3), a step-well, an irrigation well; same as vāpī.
vappaka (EI 23), a land measure. Same as vapyaka, vāpa.
vapyaka (EI 3), a land measure; same as vappaka, vāpa.
